submission.justification: Crystal-K3 gives the best simulated resolution (2.86% at 5 cm vs 4.41% for K1 and 8.58% for K2). K3 at 5 cm is better than at 3 cm (3.2%) or 8 cm (3.36%). The documents contain no intrinsic radioactivity data for any candidate, so low-background suitability is unverified. I could not rule out that K3's intrinsic activity matters. Before procurement, get the vendor's radiopurity assay for K3. If it is unacceptable, fall back to K1.

requirements.evidence: K3 2.86% at 5 cm, the lowest of the three. 3 cm gave 3.2% and 8 cm gave 3.36%. K1 4.41% and K2 8.58% at 5 cm.

requirements.requirement: Crystal is one of the three candidates

requirements.evidence: No document gives intrinsic radioactivity for any crystal. The shielding castle (20 cm Pb + 5 cm Cu, radon purge) is installed but cannot remove activity inside the crystal. K3's radiopurity needs vendor confirmation.
